maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from ticketed events, concerts, Christmas Spectacular, sponsorship and hospitality at its venues, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers, ticket buyers, sponsors and corporate clients for live events at Madison Square Garden and Radio City.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own venues, productions and events; no steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Ticket buyers and event promoters can easily choose other entertainment; the venues are distinctive but switching carries no real operational disruption.
